sloka: अग्निम् हुत्वा प्रदाय अर्घ्यम् अतिथिम् प्रतिपूजयेत् ।अन्यथा खलु काकुत्स्थ तपस्वी समुदाचरन् ।दुःसाक्षी इव परे लोके स्वानि मांसानि भक्षयेत् ॥३-१२-२९॥
transliteration: agnim hutvā pradāya arghyam atithim pratipūjayet ।anyathā khalu kākutstha tapasvī samudācaran ।duḥsākṣī iva pare loke svāni māṁsāni bhakṣayet ॥3-12-29॥

translations.english: O scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, only after offering oblations to the Firegod, a guest should be worshipped with water etc. Otherwise the host will have to eat his own flesh in the other world like a false witness.
